map.预案编制时，把行走时间、出口排队时间与预动作时间叠加得到总耗时。: When writing the plan, the walking time, exit queueing time and pre-movement time are summed to get the total time.

map.算例：100 人、出口宽 2m、流量 1.5 人/(s·m)、距离 30m、速度: Worked example: 100 people, exit width 2m, flow 1.5 persons/(s·m), distance 30m, speed 1.2m/s, pre-movement 30s
map.行走 = 30/1.2 = 25.0 s；排队 = 100/(2×1.5) =: Walking = 30/1.2 = 25.0 s; queueing = 100/(2x1.5) = 33.3 s; total evacuation = 25.0 + 33.3 + 30 = 88.3 s (about 1.47 min); exit capacity = 2x1.5 = 3.00 persons/s.
map.总时间 = 行走 + 排队 + 预动作，其中『排队 = 人数/(出口宽×单位宽度: Total time = walking + queueing + pre-movement, where 'queueing = persons / (exit width x flow per unit width)' is the most sensitive factor in the result. Widening the exit or splitting the flow can significantly cut the queueing time.
map.单位宽度人流流量取多少？: What value should the flow per unit width take?
map.常见设计取值约 1.3–1.5 人/(s·m)（水平出口），楼梯略低。实际受人员: A common design value is about 1.3-1.5 persons/(s·m) (for a level exit), slightly lower for stairs. The reality depends on the occupant mix and familiarity; this tool uses your input, and the value should reference the current evacuation design code.
map.指人员发现火情到开始撤离的反应时间（察觉、判断、广播、起身），通常 30–60: It is the reaction time from a person noticing the fire to starting evacuation (perception, judgement, alarm, getting up), usually in the 30-60 s range. It does not depend on exit capacity but accounts for a considerable share of the total evacuation time, and drills can shorten it significantly.
